body.x: OWLFS will exhibit the HUD smart black box for motorcyclesat CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA, fromJanuary 8, 2019 to January 11 (Fri).

OWLFS is a venture start-up that manufactures smart blackboxes for motorcycles. Every member of the company has experience in motorcycleleisure activities for at least 10 years with expertise in each field, and withdeep understanding and experience of motorcycles, and has made a commitment tomake products that riders really wants.

Since its establishment in August 2017, the company hasbeen developing various personal mobility products for motorcycles and bicyclesbased on optical engine design technology and camera monitoring systemtechnology. Currently, the first product, Owlfs Revan’s prototype has beendeveloped and various tests are underway.

It is important to prevent an accident because themotorcycle has a characteristic that a rider is severely injured once anaccident occurs. OWLFS products can cover for blind spots through the HUD andcan help motorist drivers' safe leisure activities by incorporating cameramonitoring system technology that warns the rider in case of danger.

The HUD smart black box for motorcycles is not a fixedhelmet, but a smart helmet can be attached to my favorite design and brandedhelmet. In addition, the maximum storage capacity goes up to 512G and it supports340 ° front and rear recording simultaneously in FHD quality. Long battery lifecan help record without missing the rider's surroundings. In addition, eachpart is modular, so you can freely choose and install the battery type,capacity, HUD type, etc. through additional optional parts.
